# Metaversal

> > A comprehensive NFT and digital collectibles newsletter covering market trends, security, platforms, and ecosystem developments.

Metaversal is Bankless's dedicated NFT publication edited by William M. Peaster, delivering weekly roundups and in-depth guides on NFT trading, art platforms, DAOs, and emerging metaverse technologies. The site combines market analysis, security education, and practical tutorials for navigating the evolving digital asset landscape.

## Key Topics

- NFT (Non-Fungible Tokens)
- Digital Collectibles
- NFT Marketplaces
- Ethereum
- DeFi
- DAO Governance
- CryptoPunks
- Nouns DAO
- OpenSea
- Zora Protocol
- Generative Art
- Play-to-Earn Gaming
- Metaverse
- Smart Contracts
- Crypto Art

## NFT Security & Best Practices

- [Guard your NFTs](https://metaversal.banklesshq.com/p/guard-your-nfts): NFT security guide: prevent scams, phishing, and protect digital assets
- [Watch what you mint 🚨](https://metaversal.banklesshq.com/p/watch-what-you-mint-): NFT security: free mint exploits, wallet safety, smart contract risks
- [Daylight for your NFT wallet ☀️](https://metaversal.banklesshq.com/p/daylight-for-your-nft-wallet): Guide to tracking NFT wallet opportunities, DeFi, DAOs, and airdrops
